security_audit.summary: All 46 static findings are false positives involving Markdown syntax, documented authentication, provider links, content identifiers, or readable Chinese prose. No evidence found of embedded secrets, malicious obfuscation, system reconnaissance, or prompt injection in the supplied files. A separate supply-chain risk remains because the documented commands automatically execute an unpinned external package with access to the runtime environment.

remediation.issue: The CLI examples automatically execute socialdatax-skills@latest without a reviewed version pin.
remediation.suggestion: Replace @latest with a reviewed exact version, verify package provenance, and require approval before first execution. Use an isolated environment with only required credentials.

content.user_title: Analyze Xiaohongshu Comments for Customer Insights
content.value_statement: Comment threads make customer needs and purchase concerns difficult to organize. This skill guides SocialDataX retrieval and turns returned comments into evidence-based themes and actions.
actual_capabilities: Guide comment retrieval through SocialDataX CLI or existing MCP tools using a note link, share text, or complete note ID.
Retrieve replies for a specified note and parent comment through documented sub-comment commands or MCP tools.
Apply documented comment sorting, page limits, item limits, and continuation tokens.
Organize returned comments into themes, pain points, purchase concerns, unmet needs, FAQs, and action suggestions.
Separate visible comment evidence from interpretation and state the sample coverage.
Guide recovery from partial results while preserving collected comments, continuation tokens, and cumulative retrieval limits.
limitations: Live retrieval requires SocialDataX credentials, network access, and a working CLI runtime or configured MCP tools; provider balance may be required.
Findings cover only returned comments and replies, not all Xiaohongshu discussions or a representative market sample.
The skill contains instructions, not the external CLI implementation; its runtime behavior and package contents were not audited here.
The documented workflow does not log in, post, like, publish comments, or modify accounts.

use_cases.title: Plan Follow-Up Content
use_cases.description: Group audience questions from a selected note into topics and follow-up content ideas, supported by visible comment evidence.

use_cases.title: Identify Product Research Questions
use_cases.description: Extract pain points, unmet needs, and purchase concerns from returned comments to guide further product research.

use_cases.title: Prepare Customer Support FAQs
use_cases.description: Turn recurring questions and reply context into an FAQ draft, separating confirmed information from questions requiring verification.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize One Note
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the first page of comments for [note URL]. Summarize themes and purchase concerns. State sample coverage and quote only returned text.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: inspect feedback on one note.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Evidence-Based FAQ
prompt_templates.prompt: Use comments from [complete note ID] to draft customer FAQs. Separate comment evidence from interpretation. Mark unanswered product questions for verification.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate a Reply Thread
prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve replies for [complete note ID] and [parent comment ID]. Identify concerns and disagreements. Distinguish reply previews from complete threads and disclose missing results.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Bounded Research Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [note URL] for [research question], using at most [page limit] pages and [item limit] comments. Identify unmet needs and actions with supporting quotes. If retrieval is partial, preserve results and resume only with valid continuation tokens within remaining limits.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: conduct bounded research with partial-result recovery.

output_examples.input: Illustrative sample: three returned comments ask about sizing and two ask about returns. Summarize concerns.
output_examples.output:
Scope: five supplied comments, not platform-wide coverage.
Themes: sizing uncertainty and return conditions.
Unmet need: clearer fit guidance.
Action: verify sizing and return policies before drafting an FAQ.

output_examples.input: Illustrative sample: one parent comment asks about durability, and a reply reports wear after one month. Suggest a research action.
output_examples.output:
Evidence: the supplied thread contains one durability question and one wear report.
Interpretation: durability needs investigation; prevalence is unknown.
Action: collect more examples and verify usage conditions before proposing a product change.

output_examples.input: A two-page retrieval stopped after one page and returned a continuation token. Describe the result.
output_examples.output:
Status: partial results only.
Coverage: one page collected; one requested page remains.
Recovery: retain collected comments and resume with the returned token after resolving the error.
Boundary: incomplete coverage must remain visible in the final analysis.

best_practices: Use a trusted, reviewed CLI version and configure the API key privately through the expected environment variable.
Set page and item limits before expanding collection, and monitor provider usage when retrieving replies.
State sample coverage, quote only returned text, and separate evidence from interpretation.
anti_patterns: Treating one note or the first page as representative of all Xiaohongshu users.
Inventing comment quotations or treating reply previews as complete conversations.
Restarting partial retrieval from the first page or using unlimited collection without an agreed usage budget.

faq.question: What input does this skill accept?
faq.answer: Provide a Xiaohongshu note link, short link, share text, or complete note ID. Specific reply retrieval also requires a parent comment ID.

faq.question: What is required for live retrieval?
faq.answer: Configure SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY and use a working Node.js/npm CLI environment or existing MCP tools. Network access and provider balance may be required.

faq.question: Does it analyze every comment on Xiaohongshu?
faq.answer: No. Analysis covers returned comments for the supplied note. Page limits, reply coverage, and retrieval failures can further restrict the sample.

faq.question: Does it publish comments or change my account?
faq.answer: The documented workflow is read-only and excludes login, posting, likes, comments, and account changes. External package behavior was not verified in this audit.

faq.question: What happens when retrieval is incomplete?
faq.answer: Keep collected results and disclose missing coverage. Resume using valid continuation tokens within remaining limits, rather than automatically restarting from the first page.

faq.question: Is an MCP server required?
faq.answer: No. The documented CLI supports agents with shell access. Existing MCP tools are an alternative when already available.
